name: Cinema
vibe: when something unexpectedly goes right which feels almost like fiction
structure: TOP: Set up a flawless scenario, unexpected win, or high-quality moment. BOTTOM: Always 'Absolute Cinema' to close the joke.
ex_top: When the rickshaw uncle takes the perfect shortcut through Dhanmondi and you arrive 20 mins early

name: cheer
vibe: when you achieve a small victory or milestone that feels like a huge success
structure: TOP: Relatable milestone, success, or achievement achieved against the odds. BOTTOM: Always 'Cheers to that'.
ex_top: When you submit the assignment 3 seconds before the deadline

name: Think
vibe: when you find a absurd loophole or technicality of a problem or limitation
structure: TOP: A rule, problem, or limitation starting with 'You can't have' or 'You can't do'. BOTTOM: A clever, absurd workaround that bypasses the problem by technicality.
ex_bottom: If bKash balance is already zero

name: Wojack
vibe: when you already in a uncertain sitation but then it becomes even worse
structure: TOP: Expectation or an ongoing normal task. BOTTOM: A sudden, devastating punchline or oversight that ruins the entire situation.
ex_top: Finally got a window seat on the Dhaka-Chittagong train

name: drugs
vibe: when you craving for something that is commonly available but suddenly becomes scarce
structure: TOP: Sudden loss or extreme deficit of an everyday essential item or service. BOTTOM: Desperate request following the rigid format 'Y'all got any more of them [Noun]?'
ex_top: When load shedding hits during a live match
ex_bottom: Y'all got any more of them generators?

name: hehe
vibe: when you do act of mischief and enjoying the chaos in secret
structure: TOP: Secretly plotting a minor prank, bad situation, or quietly watching chaos unfold. BOTTOM: A mischievous, smug punchline revealing you caused it or are enjoying it.
ex_top: Me watching my friend get grilled by the teacher
ex_bottom: For the answer I whispered wrong on purpose

name: help
vibe: Asking for any favor or support that you will probably be rejected
structure: TOP: Returning to ask for the exact same favor, support, or access after being cut off. BOTTOM: Explicitly must read 'I am once again asking for [Noun/Action]'.
ex_top: It's the 1st of the month and Abbu just got paid
ex_bottom: I am once again asking for my allowance

name: mocking
vibe: sarcastically mocking a statement that is cliche but was said with a serious tone
structure: TOP: A serious, annoying, or cliché statement made by an authority figure or company. BOTTOM: Repeat the top statement word-for-word using alternating uppercase and lowercase letters.
ex_top: Relative: Just study hard and you'll get into Buet
ex_bottom: jUsT sTuDy HaRd AnD yOu'Ll GeT iNtO bUeT

name: one_does_not
vibe: pointing a notoriously difficult everyday action that people often joke about
structure: TOP: Must strictly read 'One does not simply'. BOTTOM: Complete the sentence with a notoriously difficult, impossible, or socially delicate action.
ex_bottom: Leave a Bangladeshi wedding before the biryani is served

name: ours
vibe: when someone wants a share of something you have
structure: TOP: Someone asserting individual ownership over their [Item Name]. BOTTOM: A sudden claims shift stating rigidly: 'Our [Item Name]'. Here both the top and bottom must refer to the same item
ex_top: When you open a bag of chips in the classroom

name: rainbow
vibe: when imagination is ironically the only solution to a real-world problem
structure: TOP: Pointing out a highly unrealistic solution to a massive real-world problem. BOTTOM: A single sarcastic word, typically 'Imagination' or 'Nobody Cares'.
ex_top: How Dhaka will solve its traffic problem by 2030

name: Skeptical Kid
vibe: when you are baffled by a 1st world habit that is not necessary
structure: TOP: Must strictly begin with 'So you're telling me'. BOTTOM: Complete the sentence with an absurd, confusing, or highly questionable real-world habit.
ex_bottom: You pay money just to wake on a treadmill?

name: scientist
vibe: when you accomplish a completely mundane task but feel like a genius for doing it
structure: TOP: Accomplishing a completely basic, mundane task. BOTTOM: Must strictly follow the phrase: 'I'm something of a X myself'.Where X is a grandiose title
ex_top: When I turn off mobile data and the app finally loads
ex_bottom: I'm something of a scientist myself

name: Waiting Skeleton
vibe: waiting something that is taking forever to happen
structure: TOP: Waiting for an incredibly delayed, slow, or near-impossible future event. BOTTOM: Expressing hopeless patience like 'Still waiting' or 'Any day now'.
ex_top: Waiting for Dhaka Metro Rail to reach Uttara North

name: toy_story
vibe: seeing an overwhelming abundance of something bad that is inescapable
structure: TOP: Observing an excessive influx of bad trends, chores, or work. BOTTOM: Conclude strictly with the capitalized format '[Noun] Everywhere'.

name: Truman Director
vibe: when something is orchestrated perfectly just to be ruined by an twist
structure: TOP: A direct plan to make a setup pleasant, beautiful, or simple for someone. BOTTOM: An immediate malicious twist that completely contradicts and ruins the top setup.
ex_top: Finally get a smooth uninterrupted internet connection for an important meeting
ex_bottom: Now schedule 3 hours of load shedding

name: Futurama Fry
vibe: When you are suspicious about someone doing a sketchy action
structure: TOP: Must strictly begin with 'Not sure if [Option A]'. BOTTOM: Conclude the comparative suspicion with 'Or [Option B]'.
ex_top: Not sure if the rickshaw uncle actually doesn't know the address
ex_bottom: Or if he's taking the long route to charge double
